summary_paragraph: A woman with type 1 diabetes was admitted for acute nausea, vomiting, and diarrhea after recent exposure to a sick family member. She had been discharged just days earlier after a similar episode but developed symptoms again following contact with her ill sister. Evaluation revealed elevated blood glucose but no signs of infection, ketoacidosis, or renal impairment. She was treated for dehydration with IV fluids and monitored closely. Her symptoms resolved quickly, and she tolerated oral intake without recurrence of gastrointestinal issues. She was discharged home in stable condition with no changes to her outpatient medications and instructions to follow up with her primary care provider if symptoms returned.
